Summary: DataFjord builds a multi-tenant KB/RAG product for SaaS support platforms. Looking to replace in-house embedding+ann layer with hosted vector search + reranking pipeline. Primary goal: scale moderate index (3M - 8M docs) while serving high-concurrency query patterns (peak 600-1,200 QPS).

Key requirements / constraints:
- Indexing scale: target ~5M doc shards initially; expected monthly growth ~8-10%. Need predictable ingestion window and near-real-time updates for support articles and tickets.
- Query performance: 99th perc latency target <120ms for first-pass nearest-neighbors, end-to-end top-K (with reranker) <400ms at 800 QPS.
- Cost sensitivity: wants cost-per-query model under $0.015 average at production loads; willing to trade quantization/approximation for cost but must preserve answer accuracy for support context.
- Reranking: plan to run a bi-stage pipeline: ANN recall (vector store) -> cross-encoder reranker (small transformer) for top-10. Interested in Redwood's reranking suggestions and opportunities to offload cross-encoder to cheaper variants for cold traffic.
- Embeddings: currently using open-model embeddings (text-embedding-3-small equivalent) but evaluating Redwood model catalog for improved semantic alignment. Embedding dimension targets ~1536.
- Fallbacks/routing: need routing policy that falls back to smaller models or alternate region when latency SLOs breached.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) integration mandatory, audit logs retention 1 year, optional EU data residency for EU tenant customers. KMS integration required for key wrapping.
